systems_software.label: Low-Latency & Systems Software
systems_software.description: Prioritizes concurrency, memory efficiency, C++/Rust, and OS-level performance.
systems_software.guidance: TARGETING ANGLE: Systems Engineering. Prioritize low-latency architectures, systems programming (C++/Rust), OS kernel fundamentals, network protocol implementations, and memory management efficiency.

cloud_devops.label: Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & Site Reliability
cloud_devops.description: Prioritizes cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, containers, and resilience.
cloud_devops.guidance: TARGETING ANGLE: Cloud & Platform Engineering. Prioritize Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD orchestration, distributed monitoring/observability, and zero-downtime deployments.
